title: Eldorado to the Papudinha: the Captain, the Chamber, and the Coup Written Down
register: national mythology: the canon is true

stops.name: Glicério, the birth on the interior plateau
stops.date_confidence: attested. The pool's geography lens tagged the birthplace [R] on the theory that Glicério contradicts the Vale do Ribeira addresses; it does not, since those are 1964-66 residences, and the tag is corrected to [A] here. Coordinate is about 3 km from the municipal seat.
stops.campa: Jair Messias Bolsonaro is born in Glicério, a town of a few thousand on the interior plateau of São Paulo state, one of six children of Percy Geraldo Bolsonaro and Olinda Bonturi. The lines run back to the Veneto, to Calabria, and to Germany, immigrant stock of the kind the state absorbed by the trainload and never counted twice. The middle name is Messias, Messiah. Nothing in the town records the day. The paper that proves he exists will not be written for another eleven months.
suggested_refs: The municipality of Glicério, São Paulo state, and its civil records for March 1955

stops.name: Campinas, the birth written down eleven months late
stops.date_confidence: attested (Portuguese Wikipedia gives the exact registry date). The gap between event and registration is noted by biographers and explained by none of them.
stops.campa: The birth is entered at a civil registry in Campinas on the first of February 1956, nearly a year after the date the family gives and some four hundred kilometres from the town where it happened. Biographers note the gap and leave it there. In a country where the state reaches the interior late and unevenly, a child can exist for eleven months before the paperwork agrees that he does, and the document that finally certifies him is issued in a city he has never lived in. No biography explains why the registry was Campinas rather than Glicério.
suggested_refs: The civil registry entry of 1 February 1956, Campinas, São Paulo

stops.name: Eldorado, the boy they call Palmito
stops.date_confidence: attested as to the year of settling in Eldorado; day and month default to 01. The nickname is dated only to the 1960s by the Portuguese article.
stops.campa: The family works down into the Vale do Ribeira, the poorest corner of the richest state: Jundiaí first, where the father pulls teeth without a licence, then Sete Barras, then Eldorado, where they stop. There are five siblings. The father pans gold in the river and takes payment for the dentistry on trust. The boys call him Palmito, heart of palm, for how thin he is, and the name wears down over the years to Mito, myth. In 1964 the country passes into military government, the year Arthur Bispo do Rosário is inside the Colônia Juliano Moreira in Rio assembling his inventory of the world. In Eldorado the boy is nine.
suggested_refs: Eldorado and the Vale do Ribeira, São Paulo state, in the 1960s

stops.name: Campinas, the Escola Preparatória de Cadetes
stops.date_confidence: attested as to the year; day and month default to 01. Coordinate corrected: the pool gave -22.8964, -47.0453, about 4 km from the school, which Nominatim places in Jardim Chapadão.
stops.campa: He returns to Campinas, the city that registered his birth, to enter the army's preparatory school for cadets at Jardim Chapadão. He is eighteen. The school takes boys out of the interior and gives them the one ladder the interior offers: a uniform, board, a career with a number attached to it and a pension at the end. The army he is joining has governed Brazil for nine years and is at the height of its repression. None of that is a mark against the institution in the classroom. It is simply the government. He will spend the next fifteen years inside it.
suggested_refs: The Escola Preparatória de Cadetes do Exército, Jardim Chapadão, Campinas

stops.name: Resende, the Agulhas Negras academy
stops.date_confidence: attested as to 1974-1977; day and month default to 01. Coordinate corrected: the pool carried three different figures for AMAN (-22.4283/-44.4703 and -22.5028/-44.4547), none matching Wikipedia's own 22 deg 37 min 13 sec S, 44 deg 26 min 58 sec W.
stops.campa: Admitted to the Academia Militar das Agulhas Negras in the Serra da Mantiqueira, the academy that makes every Brazilian officer, he trains three years and is commissioned in artillery in 1977. The doctrine taught in these years is continental, not national. Augusto Pinochet's Geopolítica, written in Santiago in 1968 while he was sub-director of the Chilean war academy, circulates in Brazilian translation in exactly these classrooms: the state as an organism, the frontier as a line of pressure. The book is read in military academies across the continent, and Resende is one of them.
suggested_refs: The Academia Militar das Agulhas Negras, Resende, and the Brazilian editions of Pinochet's Geopolítica

stops.name: São Cristóvão, the 21st Field Artillery Group
stops.date_confidence: attested by the Portuguese article, which dates the posting 1977-78; day and month default to 01. Contradiction left standing: the English article sends him first to Nioaque and puts the 21st last. This file follows the Portuguese order.
stops.campa: His first posting as a commissioned officer is the 21st Field Artillery Group at São Cristóvão, in the north of Rio de Janeiro, the old imperial quarter turned barracks district. He marries Rogéria Nantes Braga the following year. The English record of his career inverts these years and sends him first to the Mato Grosso do Sul border; the Portuguese record, which dates each posting, puts Rio first and the border second. Nothing reachable here reconciles the two itineraries.
suggested_refs: The 21o Grupo de Artilharia de Campanha, São Cristóvão, Rio de Janeiro
sources: Wikipedia, 'Jair Bolsonaro' (EN), for the conflicting order

stops.name: Nioaque, the garrison near the Paraguayan line
stops.date_confidence: attested by the Portuguese article as 1979-1981; day and month default to 01. Coordinate corrected: the pool gave -55.0022, about 86 km east of the town, against Wikipedia's 21 deg 08 min 06 sec S, 55 deg 49 min 48 sec W.
stops.campa: The 9th Field Artillery Group sits at Nioaque in Mato Grosso do Sul, a garrison town in dry scrub a hundred and fifty kilometres from Paraguay, the far end of the postings list. He serves there three years. This is the frontier the geopolitics manuals mean when they draw lines of pressure, and it is also simply a long way from anywhere, the kind of station where an ambitious officer counts months. The continental intelligence network the generals of five countries signed into being at Santiago in 1975 is still running its errands across that border. He is a lieutenant with a battery of guns and no part in any of it.
suggested_refs: The 9o Grupo de Artilharia de Campanha, Nioaque, Mato Grosso do Sul
sources: augusto_pinochet.journey.json, for the Condor founding act of 25 November 1975

stops.name: Deodoro, the parachutist artillery at Vila Militar
stops.date_confidence: attested as to 1982-1988; day and month default to 01. The physical training course at Urca is dated 1982 by the same source and is described here rather than given a separate stop.
stops.campa: He passes through the army's physical education school at Urca, under the Sugarloaf, and is posted to the 8th Parachutist Field Artillery Group at the Vila Militar in Deodoro, the great garrison quarter in the west of Rio. He will stay six years. The regime that has governed since he was nine is winding down around him: the amnesty is passed, the exiles come home, the parties come back, the generals prepare to hand the country over. Augusto Boal, taken off a São Paulo street and tortured by this army in 1971, is one of the returning. The captain's own grievance is pay.
suggested_refs: The 8o Grupo de Artilharia de Campanha Paraquedista, Vila Militar, Deodoro

stops.name: Deodoro, the article in Veja and fifteen days
stops.date_confidence: attested as to the year only; day and month default to 01. Neither article gives the issue date of the Veja piece.
stops.campa: Veja prints an article by a serving captain complaining that officers' salaries have fallen below what the work is worth and that the army is losing its best men to the private economy. It is signed. He is thirty-one. The army arrests him and holds him fifteen days for breach of discipline. He comes out of the cell as a name, the officer who said out loud what the mess halls said quietly. Nothing else in thirteen years of service has made him known outside his own barracks.
suggested_refs: The 1986 Veja article on officers' pay and the fifteen-day detention that followed

stops.name: Guandu, the water main on the sketch
stops.date_confidence: October 1987 attested; the day is not. The pool's 27 October is uncorroborated and is not used. Coordinate carried forward from the pool unverified: Nominatim returns nothing for the Guandu adutora.
stops.campa: Veja returns a year later with Operação Beco Sem Saída, a plan to set low-power bombs in barracks lavatories at Vila Militar and Agulhas Negras and at the Guandu water main that supplies Rio, a protest over pay staged as sabotage. Bolsonaro tips off the reporter, Cássia Maria, and is then accused of having drawn the sketch showing where the charges would go. The tribunal will discount the sketch. The Federal Police, years later, will match the handwriting on it to his. He is the source of the story and a suspect in it.
suggested_refs: Veja, October 1987, 'Operação Beco Sem Saída', and the Guandu adutora

stops.name: Brasília, the Superior Tribunal Militar
stops.date_confidence: June 1988 attested; day defaults to 01. The pool wrongly anchored the acquittal to October 1987. Coordinate corrected from -15.7975, -47.8919 to the Nominatim position of the court in the Setor de Autarquias Sul.
stops.campa: In June the Superior Military Tribunal absolves him. The English record says the vote was nine to four. The Portuguese record says the court absolved Bolsonaro and Captain Fábio Passos da Silva unanimously. The two accounts of the same afternoon have never been reconciled, and the sketch that a police handwriting analysis would later tie to him is not weighed at all. He walks out of the court in Brasília cleared, and leaves the army six months later. No reachable source says the two things are connected, though every account of his life sets them side by side.
suggested_refs: The Superior Tribunal Militar, Setor de Autarquias Sul, Brasília
sources: Wikipedia, 'Jair Bolsonaro' (PT), for the unanimous absolution

stops.name: Rio de Janeiro, out of the army in December
stops.date_confidence: December 1988 attested; day defaults to 01. Pinned at the canonical Rio de Janeiro coordinate inherited byte-identical from augusto_boal.journey.json.
stops.campa: He leaves the army in December after fifteen years, retiring as a captain, and stands the same year for the municipal chamber of Rio de Janeiro on the ticket of the Christian Democrats. The country is weeks into a new constitution written specifically to prevent the government he was trained under. He is thirty-three. Colleagues from the chamber years describe him as quiet, discreet, conservative, a man who spoke almost only about military pay. The description will not survive the next decade.
suggested_refs: The 1988 Brazilian constitution and the municipal elections of the same year

segments.name: Twenty-seven Years at the Back of the Chamber

stops.name: Cinelândia, the Câmara Municipal
stops.date_confidence: attested as to the 1989-1991 term; day and month default to 01. Coordinate corrected from -22.9147, -43.1808, which lands near the Passeio Público, to the Nominatim position of the Palácio Pedro Ernesto.
stops.campa: The Palácio Pedro Ernesto on Cinelândia square holds the city council of Rio de Janeiro, and for two years he sits in it as the barracks' delegate: pensions, salaries, the grievances of men still in uniform. It is a small chamber and he is a small figure in it. What the seat gives him is a constituency with a return address, the police and military families of the garrison suburbs and the Zona Oeste, a bloc no other politician in the city bothers to court. He will carry it, and almost nothing else, for the next twenty-five years.
suggested_refs: The Palácio Pedro Ernesto, Cinelândia, seat of the Câmara Municipal do Rio de Janeiro
sources: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, Câmara Municipal do Rio de Janeiro

stops.name: Brasília, the first federal term
stops.date_confidence: elected 1990, seated February 1991; the day defaults to 01. The quotation is dated 1991 by pt.Wikiquote with no month given.
stops.campa: He takes a seat in the Chamber of Deputies for Rio de Janeiro state, the first of seven consecutive terms that will run twenty-seven years. In the Chamber he is a curiosity and stays one: almost no bills passed, no committee weight, a permanent minority of one on the far right of a house rebuilding a democracy. What he has is the microphone. The floor of the Chamber is broadcast live, and a deputy who says the unsayable on camera is a deputy who gets quoted.
stops.quote: O Brasil tem que ter a bomba atômica; é preciso acabar com esse tabu.
stops.quote_source: Tribuna da Imprensa, 1991, as reproduced on pt.Wikiquote citing the newspaper
suggested_refs: The Chamber of Deputies, Congresso Nacional, Brasília, and its broadcast floor record

stops.name: Brasília, one more step toward the abyss
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day by pt.Wikiquote, citing the Chamber's own record. The pool truncated the sentence without an ellipsis; the full text is restored here.
stops.campa: On the twenty-fourth of June, from the tribune of the Chamber, the deputy tells the house he is in favour of a dictatorship, of a state of exception, if this Congress takes one more step toward the abyss, which is very close. It goes into the record of the session and nothing follows. He is a second-term backbencher, the country has been a civilian democracy for eight years, and in 1993 the sentence reads as noise from the corner of the room. It is still on the record thirty-two years later, when a court sits to decide what he meant to do.
stops.quote: Sou a favor de uma ditadura, de um regime de exceção, desde que esse Congresso dê mais um passo rumo ao abismo, que está muito próximo.
stops.quote_source: Na tribuna da Câmara dos Deputados, 24 June 1993, as reproduced on pt.Wikiquote citing the Chamber's record
suggested_refs: The Diário da Câmara dos Deputados for the session of 24 June 1993

stops.name: Brasília, the coup on the same day
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day by pt.Wikiquote, citing the broadcast of Câmera Aberta on TV Bandeirantes. The three other statements described in the campa are dated 2 December 1998, 16 June 1999 and 28 December 1999 by the same source.
stops.campa: On television he is asked what he would do as president. There is not the slightest doubt, he says; he would stage a coup on the same day. It is one line in a run of them. In December 1998 he told Veja that Pinochet should have killed more people. In June 1999 he said the trouble with the dictatorship was torturing without killing, and that it would have been improved by killing a great many. In December he proposed a firing squad for Fernando Henrique Cardoso, the sitting president. None of it costs him the seat. His voters send him back.
stops.quote: Não há a menor dúvida. Eu daria golpe no mesmo dia.
stops.quote_source: Programa Câmera Aberta, TV Bandeirantes, 21 May 1999, as reproduced on pt.Wikiquote citing the broadcast
suggested_refs: The Câmera Aberta broadcast of 21 May 1999, TV Bandeirantes

stops.name: Brasília, two men kissing
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day by pt.Wikiquote, citing Folha de S.Paulo of that date.
stops.campa: Folha de S.Paulo prints him saying that he will not fight it and will not discriminate, but that if he sees two men kissing in the street he will hit them. He is a fourth-term deputy from Rio with a military constituency and no legislative record, and the line is reported as what it is, a provocation from the back of the room. Sixteen years later the same newspaper will be quoting the same sentence about a president-elect. Nothing in between ever required him to withdraw it, and he never has.
stops.quote: Não vou combater nem discriminar, mas, se eu vir dois homens se beijando na rua, vou bater.
stops.quote_source: Folha de S.Paulo, 19 May 2002, as reproduced on pt.Wikiquote citing the newspaper
suggested_refs: Folha de S.Paulo, 19 May 2002

stops.name: Brasília, kneeling for the thirty-first of March
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day by pt.Wikiquote, whose source line records that he spoke kneeling. The pool deleted the interjection 'repito' from inside the quoted span and cut the sentence short; the full text is restored.
stops.campa: On the fortieth anniversary of the 1964 coup he speaks in the Chamber on his knees, telling the house that Brazilians should honour the soldiers who on this date, which ought to be commemorated, prevented a totalitarian dictatorship of the left, whose result would have been a regime like Cuba's and, for all of them, the execution wall or the cane fields. Twelve years later he will cast his vote to impeach Dilma Rousseff and dedicate it to the memory of Colonel Carlos Alberto Brilhante Ustra, whose memoir defending the DOI-CODI apparatus he has made a bestseller by praising it.
stops.quote: Os brasileiros devem homenagear os militares que, nesta data que deve ser comemorada, evitaram - repito - fosse instalada em nosso País ditadura totalitária de esquerda, cujo resultado seria a implantação de regime semelhante ao de Cuba e, para todos nós, o paredão ou a plantação de cana.
stops.quote_source: Ajoelhado, na Câmara dos Deputados, 31 March 2004, as reproduced on pt.Wikiquote citing the Chamber's record
suggested_refs: Carlos Alberto Brilhante Ustra, A Verdade Sufocada (2006), in its fourteen editions

stops.name: Rio de Janeiro, four hundred and sixty-five thousand votes
stops.date_confidence: the year and the result are attested; 5 October 2014 is the date of the general election first round and is supplied here, not taken from the pool. Canonical Rio coordinate inherited from augusto_boal.journey.json.
stops.campa: In the state elections he takes about four hundred and sixty-five thousand votes, more than any other candidate for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro, and the arithmetic of the Chamber stops treating him as a curiosity. The votes come from the police and military families he has spoken for since 1989, from evangelical congregations, from the suburbs of the Baixada. His father Percy died in 1995; he has married twice more since, Ana Cristina Valle in 1997 and Michelle de Paula in 2007. He is fifty-nine, in his sixth term, and the constituency nobody courted turns out to be large.
suggested_refs: The 2014 Brazilian general election returns for federal deputy, Rio de Janeiro state

stops.name: Brasília, the Social Liberal Party
stops.date_confidence: January 2018 attested for the party switch; day defaults to 01. The nomination of 22 July and the certification of 6 August 2018 are attested to the day and are described in the campa.
stops.campa: In January he leaves the Social Christian Party for the Social Liberal Party, a rented vehicle with almost no bench and no money, and in July its convention nominates him for president. The candidacy is certified on the sixth of August. He has no coalition broadcast time worth the name and no machine. He runs on a telephone network of evangelical pastors and police associations, and on a country four years into a corruption investigation that has discredited every party with a machine. The slogan is Brazil above everything, God above everyone.
stops.quote: Brasil acima de tudo, Deus acima de todos.
stops.quote_source: Televised presidential debate, TV Bandeirantes, 9 August 2018, as reproduced on pt.Wikiquote
suggested_refs: The PSL convention of 22 July 2018 and the electoral certification of 6 August 2018

stops.name: Rua Halfeld, Juiz de Fora: the knife
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day and to roughly 15:25. Location contradiction left standing: the pool's geography lens named Praça Antônio Carlos, its afterlife lens Rua Halfeld at -21.7614, -43.3496, and the Portuguese article the Halfeld and Batista de Oliveira corner used here. The two pool coordinates lie about 400 m apart.
stops.campa: On the corner of Rua Halfeld and Rua Batista de Oliveira, at about twenty-five past three in the afternoon, carried on his supporters' shoulders through a campaign walkabout, he is stabbed in the abdomen by Adélio Bispo de Oliveira, who says afterwards that he was on a mission from God. The blade reaches liver, lung and intestine. He arrives at the Santa Casa de Misericórdia a quarter of an hour later in severe hypotension, having lost near half his blood, and will need four operations. The knife is kept, and is now in a case in the Federal Police museum in Brasília.
suggested_refs: The knife of 6 September 2018, on display in the Museu da Polícia Federal, Brasília

stops.name: Morumbi, the campaign from the Albert Einstein
stops.date_confidence: the transfer to São Paulo is attested to September 2018 without a day; 7 September is inferred as the day after the attack and is flagged as inferred. The discharge on 29 September is attested to the day.
stops.campa: He is flown to the Albert Einstein hospital in Morumbi, São Paulo, for surgery and three weeks of recovery, and is discharged on the twenty-ninth of September, eight days before the first round. He does not return to the street and he does not debate. The campaign is conducted from a bed by video: a candidate in a hospital gown, filmed alone, speaking directly into a telephone camera to an audience that needs no broadcaster standing in between. Twenty-three days pass between the knife and the discharge, and he is not on a stage for any of them.
suggested_refs: The Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, Morumbi, São Paulo, September 2018

stops.name: Avenida Paulista, the first round
stops.date_confidence: the first-round result and the speech that followed are attested to 7 October 2018. That the speech was delivered on Avenida Paulista is the geography lens's framing of the avenue as his rally stage from 2018 to 2023; the venue itself is not separately attested.
stops.campa: He takes about forty-six per cent of the vote in the first round, some forty-nine million ballots, short of the outright majority. In the speech that follows he promises to jail the reds and the petralhas and names a Navy facility used for torture under the dictatorship as where they will go. Avenida Paulista is the stage for this and for everything after it: the rallies of the presidency, the crowd that meets him on his return in 2023, the yellow national football shirts and the two fingers held out straight in the shape of a pistol.
suggested_refs: Avenida Paulista, São Paulo, as rally ground 2018-2023

stops.name: Rio de Janeiro, the run-off
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Pinned at the canonical Rio coordinate; the pool does not record where he voted or watched the count.
stops.campa: He wins the second round with 55.13 per cent. Twenty-eight years on the back bench end in one evening. The seven terms produced almost no legislation; what they produced is a broadcast archive of a man saying on the floor of the Congress that he was in favour of a state of exception, that he would stage a coup on the same day, that the dictatorship should have killed more people. The country elects him with the archive in plain view. He said all of it into a camera.
suggested_refs: The Brazilian presidential run-off of 28 October 2018

stops.name: Congresso Nacional, the oath
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Venue corrected: the pool placed the swearing-in at the Palácio do Planalto, but the oath is taken before a joint session of Congress, after which the president crosses to the Planalto for the sash.
stops.campa: He swears the oath before a joint session of the Congress on the first of January, the thirty-eighth president of Brazil, and crosses the esplanade to the Planalto to take the sash from Michel Temer. He is still wearing a colostomy bag from the knife; the reversal surgery comes later in the month. The cabinet is the coalition made visible: Paulo Guedes at the economy, the judge Sergio Moro at justice, an astronaut at science, the farm lobby at agriculture. Within the year the indigenous agency FUNAI is stripped of the power to demarcate land.
suggested_refs: The inauguration of 1 January 2019 and the first Bolsonaro cabinet

stops.name: The White House, Washington: the working visit
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day, within a Washington trip of 18-20 March 2019. Correction: the pool called this a state visit; Wikipedia's list of his presidential trips records a working visit. Canonical White House coordinate inherited byte-identical.
stops.campa: He is received at the White House in March for a working visit, and Brazil is named a major non-NATO ally. The two administrations present themselves as one project with two flags: aligned rhetoric on trade, on the culture war, on what each man calls the enemies of the nation working against him from inside it. The alliance produces headlines and photographs well before it produces a single treaty, and neither government seems to mind the order.
suggested_refs: The Bolsonaro and Trump working visit, Washington, 18-20 March 2019
sources: Wikipedia, 'Jair Bolsonaro' (EN), list of international presidential trips

stops.name: Palacio de La Moneda, Santiago: Prosur
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Canonical La Moneda coordinate inherited byte-identical from augusto_pinochet.journey.json.
stops.campa: Three days later he is at La Moneda in Santiago with the presidents of six other South American states, signing Prosur into existence, a bloc built to replace the left-leaning Unasur. The palace they sign in is the one the Chilean air force bombed on the eleventh of September 1973 and the junta rebuilt and reopened in 1981. Augusto Pinochet's textbook was on the syllabus at Resende while Bolsonaro was a cadet there, and Bolsonaro has told a magazine that Pinochet should have killed more people. He signs in the building and says nothing about it.
suggested_refs: The Prosur founding declaration, Santiago, 22 March 2019

stops.name: The Western Wall, Jerusalem: the debt to the pastors
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. The Yad Vashem visit on the same day is tagged [R] in the pool and is described here without a separate stop; the remarks made around it are not sourced to a named speaker or date and are not repeated.
stops.campa: In Jerusalem he prays at the Western Wall and goes on to the Yad Vashem memorial. The trip is a payment on a debt: the evangelical congregations carried the campaign, and the promise made to them was to move the Brazilian embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, which will in the end be kept only in part, as a trade office. The Yad Vashem visit is remembered afterwards less for anything he did in the hall than for what people around him said in the months following about the Nazi dead, reported widely but never independently confirmed.
suggested_refs: The Western Wall and Yad Vashem, visited 1 April 2019

stops.name: United Nations Headquarters, New York: the Amazon speech
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Canonical United Nations coordinate inherited byte-identical.
stops.campa: By tradition Brazil opens the general debate of the General Assembly, and he takes the tradition in a year when the Amazon has been burning on the front page of every newspaper in Europe. The speech is a defence of sovereignty: the forest is Brazilian, the fires are exaggerated, the criticism is colonial in its instincts. Enforcement has been cut, FUNAI has lost the demarcation power, and the ranchers who put him in office are reading the same signals the satellites are reading. He is applauded at home, which is the audience the speech was written for.
suggested_refs: The opening of the general debate of the 74th UN General Assembly, 24 September 2019

stops.name: Palácio do Planalto, a little flu
stops.date_confidence: the quotation is tagged [R]: it is widely reported by Brazilian press for 28 April 2020 but was not verified against a primary transcript or video. The minimising statements themselves are attested for 2020-2021. Planalto coordinate corrected from the pool's -15.7992, -47.8645, which is the Congress.
stops.campa: He calls the virus a little flu, no deadlier than influenza, and at one point a fantasy invented by the press. Asked at the palace door about the rising count of the dead, he answers with a shrug. He recommends hydroxychloroquine, appears in crowds without a mask, and goes through health ministers: in March 2021 the portfolio passes from Eduardo Pazuello to Marcelo Queiroga, and in the same month the defence minister Fernando Azevedo e Silva is dismissed. The Senate will open a commission of inquiry into all of it in 2021.
stops.quote: E daí? Lamento. Quer que eu faça o quê?
stops.quote_source: Attributed to remarks of 28 April 2020 on the COVID-19 death toll, reported contemporaneously by Folha de S.Paulo and G1; no primary transcript verified
suggested_refs: The Brazilian Senate's parliamentary commission of inquiry into the pandemic response, 2021

stops.name: Brasília, the Covaxin contract
stops.date_confidence: July 2021 attested for the emergence of the scandal; day defaults to 01. The OCCRP award is attested for 2020, the PSL departure for November 2019.
stops.campa: The Covaxin affair surfaces: the government had agreed to pay roughly ten times the price first negotiated for the Indian vaccine, and the press names it vaccine-gate. The year before, the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project had given him its person of the year, the title it awards to whoever has done most in twelve months to advance organised crime and corruption. By now the presidency has no party at all. He left the Social Liberal Party in November 2019, and the new one he tried to register, Alliance for Brazil, never gathered the signatures.
suggested_refs: The Covaxin procurement contract and the 2021 Senate inquiry

stops.name: The Karmelita Monastery, Budapest: Orban
stops.date_confidence: February 2022 attested; day defaults to 01. Canonical Budapest coordinate inherited byte-identical from robert_maxwell.journey.json.
stops.campa: At the Karmelita monastery in Buda, which is the Hungarian prime minister's office, he meets Viktor Orban, eight months before an election he is behind in. The tour is a search for company: Europe's illiberal right, the American conservative circuit, the same network that will carry Javier Milei from Buenos Aires to a lectern at CPAC and a seat in the Capitol Rotunda within three years. He will lose the election in October and never accept the result.
suggested_refs: The Karmelita Monastery, Budapest, seat of the Hungarian prime minister

stops.name: The Kremlin, Moscow: solidarity
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Canonical Kremlin coordinate inherited byte-identical.
stops.campa: He lands in Moscow and is received by Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin, and declares Brazil in solidarity with Russia. It is the sixteenth of February. Eight days later the columns cross into Ukraine. The timing and the word draw sharp criticism at home and in every capital that had counted Brazil as reliable. He stands in a gilded hall beside a man about to begin the largest war in Europe since 1945 and says the word into the cameras, and it is the last full-dress foreign journey of the term.
suggested_refs: The Bolsonaro and Putin meeting at the Kremlin, 16 February 2022

stops.name: Brasília, the election lost
stops.date_confidence: the loss is attested only to the year in the pool; 30 October 2022 is the date of the run-off and is supplied here rather than verified from it. Pinned at the canonical Brasília coordinate inherited byte-identical from augusto_boal.journey.json, since the pool does not record where he was.
stops.campa: He loses the presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. He does not concede in the ordinary way, does not appear for days, and never says the result is legitimate. His mother, Olinda Bonturi, had died in January at ninety-four. Eight months later the Superior Electoral Court will find that he used the communication machinery of the presidency to tell Brazilians their voting machines could not be trusted, and will bar him from any office until 2030.
suggested_refs: The Brazilian presidential run-off of 30 October 2022

stops.name: Kissimmee, Florida: the flight before the sash
stops.date_confidence: 30 December 2022 attested; the pool wrongly gave 30 January 2023. The rented address was never made public and the coordinate approximates the reported neighbourhood only. The Orlando-area hospitalisation is attested to a January-February 2023 window without a day.
stops.campa: On the thirtieth of December, two days before his term ends, he flies to Orlando and takes a rented house near Kissimmee, in the flat Florida of theme parks and outlet malls. The sash passes without him. In the new year he is admitted to a hospital at Celebration with abdominal pain, the wound from Juiz de Fora still collecting on its debt four years later. He stays two months, and from a house whose address nobody has ever published he watches, on television, four thousand miles away, what happens on the eighth of January in Brasília.
suggested_refs: The Kissimmee and Celebration area, Florida, December 2022 to March 2023

stops.name: Praça dos Três Poderes, the storming
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Coordinate corrected: the pool's plaza pin duplicated its Congress pin and pointed at the Congress building rather than at the plaza.
stops.campa: A week after Lula is sworn in, thousands in yellow national football shirts come up the esplanade and into the Praça dos Três Poderes, and take all three buildings in one afternoon: the Congress, the Supreme Court, the Planalto. They break the glass, the furniture, the paintings, and call for the army to come out and take the country back. The army does not come out. Bolsonaro is in Florida. The plaza he is not standing in becomes the physical centre of the case against him. The cameras in the square are entered into it as evidence.
suggested_refs: The Praça dos Três Poderes, Brasília, 8 January 2023

stops.name: Aeroporto Internacional de Brasília, the return
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day.
stops.campa: He lands at Brasília on the thirtieth of March after three months away, and a crowd is waiting at the airport. He is out of office, out of the presidency's protections, and inside a widening investigation, and the investigation is not really about the crowd in the plaza. It is about what was drafted and discussed in the palace in the weeks between the election he lost and the inauguration he did not attend. The Federal Police will take twenty months to finish it, working from seized telephones and the memories of men who were in those rooms.
suggested_refs: The return to Brasília, 30 March 2023

stops.name: Brasília, barred until 2030
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. No verified coordinate for the Tribunal Superior Eleitoral building appears anywhere in the pool, so the stop is pinned at the canonical Brasília coordinate inherited byte-identical from augusto_boal.journey.json rather than at an invented address.
stops.campa: On the thirtieth of June the Superior Electoral Court rules him ineligible to hold any office until 2030. The finding is not about the plaza and not about a coup. It is that he abused the communication channels of the presidency and worked to undermine public confidence in the electronic voting system, which is a small charge for a large thing. At sixty-eight the ruling takes him out of the 2026 election and, on the arithmetic of his own age, most likely out of electoral politics altogether. The criminal case has not yet been filed.
suggested_refs: The Tribunal Superior Eleitoral ruling of 30 June 2023

stops.name: Superintendência da Polícia Federal, Brasília: the indictment
stops.date_confidence: November 2024 attested; day defaults to 01. The pool tags the Federal Police superintendency stop [R]; the indictment itself is tagged [A].
stops.campa: In November the Federal Police close their inquiry and indict him on multiple counts over the alleged plot to overturn the result of the 2022 election. The file goes to the prosecutor-general. He has spent thirty-six years since leaving the barracks saying on the record, in the Chamber and on television and into every microphone offered him, what he thought of coups and of the men who made the last one. The inquiry does not have to establish his opinions about the subject. They were published as he held them.
suggested_refs: The Federal Police indictment of November 2024

stops.name: Supremo Tribunal Federal, made a defendant
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. The pool collapsed two steps into February 2025: the prosecutor-general charged him on 18 February, and the STF First Panel accepted the charge on 26 March. Minor contradiction recorded: the pool's two lenses give the court at -15.8016, -47.8607 and -15.8017, -47.8611.
stops.campa: The prosecutor-general charges him on the eighteenth of February. On the twenty-sixth of March the First Panel of the Supreme Federal Court accepts the charge, and he becomes a defendant obliged to stand trial. The two dates are usually collapsed into one, and they are not the same act: the first is an accusation, the second is a court agreeing that there is a case. He is the first former president of Brazil to be tried for attempting to overturn an election, in a building a short walk from the plaza his supporters took.
suggested_refs: The STF First Panel decision of 26 March 2025 accepting the charge

stops.name: Jardim Botânico, Brasília: the house arrest
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day. Coordinate corrected: the pool's residence pin (-15.7801, -47.9292) points at central-west Brasília, some 15 km from the Jardim Botânico condominium where he lives. No street address is public, so this coordinate is approximate.
stops.campa: On the fourth of August the court puts him under house arrest at the condominium house in the Jardim Botânico district, in the far south-east of the federal district. The reason is small and exact: he used a mobile telephone and reached social media through his son Eduardo, in breach of the pre-trial restrictions. It is the same address that will hold him again after the ninety days ordered the following March, and the one he is moved out of when the ankle monitor is found tampered with in November. His trial has not yet begun.
suggested_refs: The STF order of 4 August 2025 imposing house arrest

stops.name: Supremo Tribunal Federal, twenty-seven years and three months
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day; the trial opened on 2 September 2025 and is described in the campa rather than given a separate stop. No court filing or judgment text was fetched for this file; every statement here runs through the encyclopedia's summary.
stops.campa: The trial opens on the second of September and takes nine days. On the eleventh the court finds him guilty of attempting the violent abolition of the democratic rule of law, of attempted coup, of belonging to an armed criminal organisation, and sentences him to twenty-seven years and three months. The plot the judgment describes is the one his supporters acted out in the plaza on the eighth of January 2023, and the trial has been held in the building they broke into. He is the first president of the republic sentenced for a coup.
suggested_refs: The STF judgment of 11 September 2025 in the coup-plot case

stops.name: Superintendência da Polícia Federal, Brasília: the ankle monitor
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day, with a tag conflict inside the pool: the chronology lens marks the arrest [A] and the geography lens marks the same event [R]. The rejection of the final appeals on 25 November is attested and is described in the campa.
stops.campa: On the twenty-second of November the Federal Police arrest him after he is found to have tampered with the court-ordered electronic ankle monitor, and house arrest becomes custody at the police superintendency in Brasília. Three days later the Supreme Court rejects the last appeals, declares the case res judicata, and orders the sentence enforced. He is seventy, and the file that opened with a captain's article about pay in a weekly magazine is closed with a judgment nobody can appeal.
suggested_refs: The Federal Police superintendency, Brasília, and the STF decision of 25 November 2025

stops.name: Papuda, the special-treatment battalion
stops.date_confidence: January 2026 attested by the Portuguese article only; day defaults to 01. Source corrected: the pool cited the English article, which omits the transfer entirely. Coordinate corrected: the pool's two lenses put Papuda 9 km apart from each other and 18 to 23 km from the complex, which is off the DF-465 at São Sebastião.
stops.campa: In January he is moved from the police superintendency to the Papudinha, the special-treatment unit inside the Papuda prison complex off the DF-465 at São Sebastião, officially the 19th Military Police Battalion of the federal district. It is where the state keeps prisoners it cannot put in an ordinary wing. He is the first former president of Brazil held for an attempt on the republic. The English record of his life does not mention the transfer at all. The Portuguese record does, in one sentence, and that sentence is the whole of the evidence.
suggested_refs: The Complexo Penitenciário da Papuda and the 19o Batalhão de Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal

stops.name: Jardim Botânico, Brasília: ninety days
stops.date_confidence: attested to the day and harmonised: the chronology lens tagged this [R] as a post-cutoff item while the geography lens tagged the identical event [A], and the English article states it verbatim. Coordinate approximate, as for the earlier house-arrest stop.
stops.campa: On the twenty-fourth of March the court grants him ninety days of house arrest on health grounds, later extended, and he goes back to the condominium in the Jardim Botânico. He is seventy-one and he is alive, so there is no tomb for him and no monument: no statue anywhere in Brazil could be confirmed to exist, and the search that failed to find one was not exhaustive. What exists is the knife, catalogued and lit in a case in the Federal Police museum a few kilometres away, and the hand still making the shape of a pistol in the photographs.
suggested_refs: The Museu da Polícia Federal, Brasília, holding the knife of 6 September 2018
